source: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4 p43

design.source: V23/V24.1 version-2 schema + V24 134-row synthetic commit
design.allowed_storage: two automatically deleted temp directories with mavenu-v24- prefix and v24_synthetic.sqlite3 filename
integrity_checks: physical file SHA-256 after closed handle
design.error_telemetry: stable non-sensitive error code; status FAILED, never SUCCESS

limitations: Daily cron is a *design schedule only*. No unattended GitHub Actions schedule, external scheduler, retention service or background task is activated.
All successful backup copies are created, verified and deleted within a single test run; there is no recoverable retained snapshot after test termination.

SQLite online backup plus reopen and receipt verification is not proof of power-loss resilience, encrypted at-rest backup, off-site redundancy, long-term immutability or independent production disaster recovery.
Tests operate only on fabricated 134-row examples with no actual customer identity, tenant RLS or customer data license.
Tamper detection relies on a hash/receipt in the same untrusted test environment, not a signed external audit or privileged insider protection.
V28 deletion/retention and V29 independent recovery testing remain future gates; V10/V20 and V21-V27 human signoffs are unresolved.
operator_gates: Customer data owner approves backed-up data classes and legal rights
DBA and security owner approve target database, backup encryption, keys and least privilege
Approve schedule/retention/off-site storage and monitoring duty roster
Verify restore into isolated environment, measure RPO/RTO and exercise failure response
Approve deletion/hold/retention policy and tenant-scoped backup/export boundaries
Resolve V10/V20 formal readiness and V21-V27 signoffs
